criteria.criterion: Resolve the supplied ISBN-13 on Open Library to the correct edition
criteria.description: Use ISBN 9780141439518 to open the ISBN-resolved edition on Open Library (i.e., the edition page reached via that ISBN/ISBN lookup). Full credit if the agent clearly uses the ISBN to reach the specific edition and does not substitute metadata from another edition/work page. Partial credit if the agent reaches a plausible Pride and Prejudice edition but does not demonstrate it is the ISBN-resolved one. Full credit if Open Library is inaccessible (down/CAPTCHA/errors) or the ISBN cannot be resolved due to site behavior, as long as the agent clearly reports the blocker encountered and what it attempted (e.g., retrying or using the ISBN URL).

evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Partial support at best. However, the screenshot does not provide evidence that the page shown is the ISBN-resolved edition for ISBN 9780141439518 (e.g., no visible ISBN link, no ISBN-resolved URL displayed, and no “ISBN” field shown). Therefore, the screenshot cannot confirm that the agent resolved the supplied ISBN to the correct edition rather than using a general edition/work context.
